learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will identify naming words and learn the difference between Common, Proper, and Collective Nouns.]
warm_up_hook: 🔍 Look around you! The chair, your notebook, your friend, the city you live in—everything has a name. Let's put on our detective glasses and explore the world of Nouns!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏷️ What is a Noun? (संज्ञा क्या है?)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A noun is a naming word. It is the name of a person, place, animal, or thing.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🌍 Common and Proper Nouns (जातिवाचक और व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Common Noun is a general name for any person, place, or thing. A Proper Noun is the special name of a particular person, place, or thing. Proper Nouns ALWAYS begin with a Capital Letter!
Sometimes we talk about a whole group of people, animals, or things as one single unit. The special word we use for that group is called a Collective Noun.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following is a Proper Noun?
❓ What is the correct collective noun for cows?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the Common Noun and underline the Proper Noun: 'My friend Sita is going to Mumbai.'
subjective_practice.hint: Which words are special names (capitalized), and which word is just a general name?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the correct collective noun: A __________ of keys.
subjective_practice.hint: It's the same word you use for a group of grapes!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write two Proper Nouns for the Common Noun 'festival'.
subjective_practice.hint: Think of the holidays you celebrate where you get sweets or burst crackers.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🕵️ Noun Treasure Hunt
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Walk around your house and make a list of: 3 Common Nouns you can see, 3 Proper Nouns (names of your family members or books), and try to find 1 thing that belongs to a Collective Noun (like a bunch of bananas)!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Nouns are names of persons, places, animals, or things.
⭐ Common nouns are general names, while Proper nouns are special, specific names.
⭐ Proper nouns always start with a capital letter.
⭐ Collective nouns are special names for groups of things, animals, or people.
